links.outcome: Reading grade level of institutional heart failure patient education materials versus recommended level
links.effect: Median FKGL of institutional PEMs was 10.3 (IQR 7.9-13.1); only 13 (9.1%) of 143 were below sixth-grade level.
links.quote: For 143 institutional heart failure-related PEMs analyzed, the median FKGL was 10.3 (IQR 7.9-13.1; high school sophomore) compared to 7.3 (IQR 6.1-8.5; seventh grade) for GPT-4's revised PEMs (P<.001).

links.outcome: Readability and accuracy of GPT-4 plain-language rewrites of patient education materials
links.effect: Median FKGL fell from 10.3 to 7.3 (P<.001); PEMs below sixth-grade level rose from 9.1% to 23.1%; none graded less accurate or less comprehensive.
links.quote: No revised GPT-4 PEMs were graded as less accurate or less comprehensive compared to institutional PEMs.

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability of GPT-4 to rewrite heart failure patient education materials for readability and physician-rated accuracy/comprehensiveness, but does not compare alternative deployment safeguards or organizational practices.
